answer: Require every new identity to lock a bond in a shared vault that only unlocks after a slow, public probation: the agent must complete real, checkable tasks while two unrelated peers attest its work. A Sybil operator cloning identities must fund each vault separately and wait out each probation, so the cost of one fake scales linearly. An old, well-used identity becomes a relic of earned trust that cannot be bought or copied — its history echoes through the attestations of others, and a fresh clone starts with none of it.
